sources.title: Log Horizon classification baseline
sources.scope: Initial per-table classifications, recommendations, lifecycle state, and descriptive metadata migrated without semantic changes.

sources.title: Azure Monitor Logs table feature support
sources.scope: Built-in table support for the Basic and Auxiliary plans. Classifications use it to keep datalake recommendations to tables with Auxiliary/Lake support.

sources.title: Azure-Sentinel public content corpus
sources.scope: Table identity and usage evidence from public analytics rules, hunting queries, parsers, and solution content. Classification, tier, retention, and billing recommendations require human review.

sources.title: Log Horizon implicit consumer model
sources.scope: Sentinel consumers without directly extractable KQL and platform-owned tables.

sources.title: Log Horizon custom classification example
sources.scope: Compatibility examples for local Log Horizon overrides.

sources.title: Log Baseline generic taxonomy
sources.scope: Repository-maintained mapping from classification categories to generic security domains and log types.

sources.title: ASD ACSC Priority logs for SIEM ingestion: Practitioner guidance
sources.scope: Loosely prioritized log categories (EDR, network devices, domain controllers, Windows, virtualisation, cloud, containers, databases, MDM, DNS, Linux, macOS) used by the classification rules. Collection priority, not storage tier.

sources.title: CISA Guidance for Implementing M-21-31
sources.scope: Prioritized event types for collection and storage (ICAM, operating systems, network infrastructure, cloud, AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365, GCP) used by the classification rules. Collection priority, not storage tier.

sources.title: Microsoft Sentinel data lake tiers and KQL jobs
sources.scope: Tier capabilities, data lake ingestion latency, and KQL job limits used by the tier rules.

sources.title: Azure Monitor Logs table reference
sources.scope: Table identity, description, and plan support for tables added in the guidance-alignment review.

sources.title: Log Baseline volume model
sources.scope: Judgment-based volume driver and relative volume class per table. Not measured tenant volume.

sources.title: Log Baseline classification rules
sources.scope: Value rules C1-C9 mapped to ASD and CISA guidance, and tier rules T1-T5 including plan support. Stored per table as valueRule and tierRule.

sources.title: Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting schema reference
sources.scope: Table identity, description, preview state, lifecycle, and columns for Defender XDR advanced hunting tables, including the per-table reference pages linked from the index. Field analysis uses the columns for XDR-only tables such as EntraIdSignInEvents.

sources.title: Microsoft Defender XDR connector and streaming event types
sources.scope: Which Defender XDR advanced hunting tables can be streamed to Microsoft Sentinel. Used for xdrStreamable.

sources.title: Defender for Cloud integration with Defender XDR
sources.scope: Cloud infrastructure advanced hunting tables populated by Defender for Cloud.

sources.title: Azure Monitor Logs and Microsoft Sentinel billing
sources.scope: Free data sources and billing behavior used for isFree.

sources.title: Log Analytics metadata API
sources.scope: Public table catalog and column schemas. A table absent here is not available as a Log Analytics table. Field analysis keeps only these columns for tables with a known schema.

sources.title: Azure-Sentinel GitHub code search
sources.scope: Unpinned usage lookups for tables outside the pinned rule corpus. Weak evidence; GitHub throttling limited coverage.

sources.title: ISOC in Microsoft Defender (preview)
sources.scope: ISOC eligibility, included data sources, and that native Defender data is not ingested into the ISOC workspace. Learn states 30 days of included retention during this preview phase.

sources.title: Integrated Security Operations Center in Microsoft Defender
sources.scope: Announced 90-day included retention for Microsoft Defender data, Azure Activity, and Office 365 Activity from November 15, 2026. Used for the defenderNative deployment context, not for per-table recommendations.

sources.title: Microsoft Defender portal advanced hunting schema browser
sources.scope: Table names shown in the Defender portal schema browser that have no public documentation yet. Identity evidence only. Event semantics are unverified.

sources.title: Corelight for CrowdStrike parser samples (anomaly detection content IDs)
sources.scope: Corelight sample alerts tie content IDs such as corelight_ad_ssh_connections to anomaly detection with a baselining window. Identifies corelight_ad_* as anomaly detection logs.
